feature_contract.goal: Correct a real shipped R26+HUD IndexedPrimitiveUP wrap/oversized stereo scratch defect by transforming only the declared UP window for both eyes; keep the full R30 topology bounded.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: DX9Ex R26+HUD/R30 indexed UP vertex staging, bounded-topology utility and portable smoke. No shader, SkyGlow, transport, DX11, DXVK, localization or FFB change.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Shipped R26+HUD computed max(minVertexIndex+numVertices,maxIndex+1) in UINT and transformed the absolute unused vertex prefix, exposing overflow and excessive CPU/memory cost.
trace_stages: Overflow-safe topology/vertex-window bounds and referenced indices
Compacted source and rebased per-eye indexed UP draws
Preserve original Draw on failed stereo admission
Exact-SHA Windows game/host/package and Domain gates
subcomponents: Safe topology and 32-bit arithmetic in both compiled owners
Compact R26+HUD indexed vertex window and index stream consistently for both eyes
Negative/positive portable regression through Windows workflow

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both eye buffers index the same bounded, compacted vertex window when minVertexIndex > 0.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Malformed bounds and original game draw
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Invalid primitive/window/out-of-range indices are not admitted into stereo transform, and delegate to legacy/original Draw.
Windows portable smoke plus DX9Ex Active x86 game/x64 host/package and required Domain/Full Source gates pass at same commit SHA.

diagnosis.root_cause: Unchecked UINT primitive/indexed UP window operations and unrebased absolute source window in the default R26+HUD rendering owner.
alternatives_rejected: No generic state changes, alpha suppression, reduced resolution or speculative HMD acceptance.

runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR or original game session on this SHA.

validation_evidence.notes: No game/HMD execution on this SHA; static build and policy gates are not Quest3 gameplay certification.
